name: Bioinformatics
summary: Computational tools for biological sequences and data: databases, alignment, sequence search, variant and expression analysis, and phylogenetics.

topics.name: Biological databases: GenBank, UniProt, PDB, Ensembl
File formats: FASTA, FASTQ, SAM/BAM, VCF, GFF
Pairwise alignment: dot plots, Needleman-Wunsch, Smith-Waterman and scoring matrices
Database search: BLAST and its statistics
Profiles, motifs and hidden Markov models (Pfam, HMMER)
Protein structure and function prediction tools
Workflow managers, the command line and HPC for biology
Gene ontology and pathway enrichment analysis
